steps.title: Suggest mode
steps.text: Images you marked one by one are starting points. Images similar to them get the same label as a suggestion. A suggestion is not a label until you accept it.

steps.title: What the frames mean
steps.text: Each frame colour is a suggested label; grey means no suggestion.

steps.title: An image you marked
steps.text: Its label, and how many unjudged images are similar to it.

steps.title: Label the whole group
steps.text: Any button marks every image in the group. The dashed one is the suggestion.

steps.title: Or decide image by image
steps.text: The buttons under an image set its own label.
